description.fun: Illumise runs the light show: its sweet scent draws in Volbeat, which then trace glowing geometric patterns across the sky. An Illumise earns respect by composing more complex designs, and over 200 different patterns have been recorded. Its purple curls may borrow from the bobbed hair of 1920s flappers. And it's pronounced 'EE-loom-MEE-zay'.
description.guide: A Bug-type Pokémon based on a firefly, always female and active at night; Volbeat is its male counterpart. It guides swarms of Volbeat to draw patterns in the sky. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A firefly choreographer that directs Volbeat light shows
